zh.heroKicker: 基于 Gaia + LAMOST 的全天数据
zh.heroTitle:
银河系三维尘埃消光
查询平台
zh.heroDesc: 输入任意视线方向的银道坐标 (l, b) 与距离 d，即可获得累积消光 E(B−V)、尘埃密度、不确定度、最大可信距离与分子云信息。
zh.heroCitePre: Wang, Yuan, Chen, et al. 2025 · ApJS 280, 15
zh.vizCaption: 银河系尘埃三维分布 · 太阳居中
zh.featTitle: 四个工具，同一套尘埃模型
zh.featSub: 查询、成图、批量与坐标换算——都在二级控制台里输入并即时得到结果。这里先用一分钟了解每个功能能做什么。
zh.sec1Sub: 单点与批量查询——输入银道或赤道坐标，即时得到累积消光 E(B−V) 及其不确定度。
zh.querySub: 内置坐标系换算——直接输入赤道坐标也可，平台自动转换为银道坐标后查询。
zh.demoBadge: 示例数据 · 非真实查询
zh.emptyState: 输入坐标与距离，点击「查询消光」查看结果
zh.noCloud: 该视线方向未命中分子云
zh.warnMax: 查询距离已超过该视线最大可信距离 {d} kpc，外推结果仅供参考。
zh.bandTitle: 波段消光 A_λ（红化系数换算）
zh.bandNote: 系数为典型 R_V = 3.1 取值，仅作演示；可在「资源」中下载本工作发布的完整红化系数表替换。
zh.plotSub: 设定绘图区域（坐标系、l/b/d 范围）与绘图参数（高斯核 σ、颜色范围、颜色缩放与颜色映射），选择投影方式后生成累积消光 E(B−V) 天图。
zh.plotColorRange: 颜色编码范围（最小 / 最大）
zh.batchSub: 粘贴多行坐标（每行：a, b, d），一次性计算并导出 CSV，支持银道或赤道输入。
zh.batchInputLabel: 坐标列表（每行：l/RA, b/Dec, d）
zh.batchNone: 未解析到有效行（每行需 3 个数：a, b, d）。
zh.curveTitle: 累积消光 E(B−V) vs 距离（虚线＝可信上限）
zh.toolsSub: 把零散的小工具收进统一界面：坐标换算结果可一键送入上方的消光查询。
zh.sendToQuery: 用此银道坐标查询消光
zh.pkgSub: 约 350 MB 的轻量参数化模型，支持本地批量、高速查询任意视线。
zh.bcpSub: 基于同一套三维尘埃数据的在线绘图服务——围绕任意银道视线方向绘制“尘埃气泡”三联图，由国家天文科学数据中心（NADC）托管。
bcpPoints: 设定银经/银纬中心与气泡直径，选取距离范围 d，一键生成三图合成结果
颜色映射、颜色缩放与高斯平滑核均可调，支持自定义颜色编码范围
支持 CSV 批量上传标记与结果导出，生成图可直接下载
zh.citeSub: 如果本工作对您的研究有帮助，请引用以下文献。
zh.resSub: 查询与工具之外的支撑材料——按用途分组，与上方交互工具区分开，便于查找与引用。
zh.resNote: 以上为占位链接与示意文件大小；接入真实发布地址、文件与版本号后即可直接下载。
zh.notesIntro: 以下是我重构前对原平台梳理出的主要问题，以及在这个 demo 中对应的改进做法。
zh.footer: 3D Dust Map Platform — 重构演示 · 非官方

critiques.title: 视觉风格不统一
critiques.before: 政府门户外壳套着独立小工具，配色、字体、圆角、间距各成一套，像拼接而来。
critiques.after: 建立单一设计系统：明亮白底＋紫蓝主色、统一字族与圆角/间距/阴影，全站一致。

critiques.title: 信息层级混乱、缺少主操作
critiques.before: 查询、结果、文档、引用、下载平铺堆叠，没有重点，用户不知从哪开始。
critiques.after: 明确英雄区＋唯一主操作（查询），核心按 01–03 编号分区，下载/系数/文档下沉到独立「资源」带。

critiques.title: 输入输出割裂、无可视化
critiques.before: 平台只收银道坐标，手里是 RA/Dec 得自己换算；结果只有数字，无上下文。
critiques.after: 内置坐标系切换与自动换算；结果配累积消光曲线＋天球定位图，并标注单位与 σ。

critiques.title: 缺乏引导与术语解释
critiques.before: 不解释 E(B−V)、mag/kpc、最大可信距离的含义，新手困惑、专家也要猜约定。
critiques.after: 每个指标配简短释义与坐标约定标签，红化系数就近放在结果里直接换算。

critiques.title: 交互直觉差
critiques.before: 纯文本链接、无悬停/聚焦反馈、无错误与越界提示，移动端布局断裂。
critiques.after: 清晰的按钮/分段控件/聚焦态与悬停动效、错误与超距警告、响应式栅格。

critiques.title: 工具与主业务脱节
critiques.before: 字符统计与消光无关、坐标工具与查询各造轮子，功能漂移、彼此孤立。
critiques.after: 坐标转换结果一键「送入查询」，通用工具收进统一工具区，资源材料独立成区，形成闭环。

en.heroKicker: Built on Gaia + LAMOST all-sky data
en.heroDesc: Enter Galactic coordinates (l, b) and a distance d along any line of sight to get cumulative E(B−V), dust density, uncertainty, the maximum reliable distance and molecular-cloud information.
en.heroCitePre: Wang, Yuan, Chen, et al. 2025 · ApJS 280, 15
en.featSub: Query, mapping, batch and coordinate conversion — you run them in the Console and get results instantly. Here, take a minute to see what each one does.
en.sec1Sub: Single-point and batch queries — enter Galactic or equatorial coordinates and get cumulative E(B−V) with its uncertainty instantly.
en.querySub: Coordinate conversion built in — enter equatorial coordinates too and the platform converts to Galactic for you.
en.demoBadge: DEMO DATA · not a live query
en.emptyState: Enter coordinates and distance, then press “Query extinction”.
en.noCloud: No molecular cloud on this sightline
en.warnMax: Distance exceeds the max reliable value {d} kpc on this sightline; extrapolated.
en.bandNote: Coefficients are typical R_V = 3.1 values, illustrative only; download the published reddening-coefficient table under “Resources” to replace them.
en.plotSub: Set the map region (coordinate frame, l/b/d ranges) and plot parameters (Gaussian σ, color range, color scale and colormap), pick a projection, then generate the cumulative E(B−V) sky map.
en.plotHint: Click the map to pick a sightline →
en.batchSub: Paste many coordinate rows (a, b, d per line), compute in one pass and export CSV — Galactic or equatorial input.
en.batchInputLabel: Coordinate list (per line: l/RA, b/Dec, d)
en.batchNone: No valid rows parsed (each line needs 3 numbers: a, b, d).
en.curveTitle: Cumulative E(B−V) vs distance (dashed = reliable limit)
en.toolsSub: Scattered helpers in one place — coordinate results can be sent straight to the query above.
en.sendToQuery: Use these Galactic coords to query
en.pkgSub: A compact (~350 MB) parametric model for fast local batch queries along any sightline.
en.bcpSub: An online plotting service on the same 3D dust data — draws three-panel “dust bubble” maps around any Galactic sightline, hosted by the National Astronomical Data Center (NADC).
bcpPoints: Set the (l, b) centre, bubble diameter and distance range d, then generate the composite three-panel figure in one click
Adjustable colormap, colour scaling and Gaussian smoothing kernel, with custom colour-range limits
CSV batch upload for markers, result export, and direct download of generated figures
en.citeSub: If this work is useful to your research, please cite the paper below.
en.resSub: Supporting material beyond the query and tools — grouped by purpose and kept separate from the interactive area so it is easy to find and cite.
en.resNote: Links and file sizes above are placeholders; wire in the real release URLs, files and version numbers to enable direct downloads.
en.notesIntro: The main problems I found on the original platform before the redesign, and how this demo addresses each.
en.footer: 3D Dust Map Platform — redesign demo · unofficial

resources.title: Data downloads
resources.desc: Parametric model and gridded extinction data for local batch and offline use.

resources.title: Reddening coefficients
resources.desc: A_λ / E(B−V) tables per photometric system to convert reddening into band extinction.

resources.title: Documentation
resources.desc: User guide, API reference and release notes, with coordinate conventions and units.

directions.name: Bright product (this build)
directions.desc: White canvas, purple-blue accents, generous whitespace and silky hovers — Stripe-style typography and motion. The direction this demo ships.

directions.name: Instrument panel
directions.desc: Inputs and multi-metric results side by side; maximal data density, research-leaning.

directions.name: Dark sky map
directions.desc: Full-bleed dark starfield + dust glow, immersive visualization first, good for large displays.

critiques.title: Inconsistent visual style
critiques.before: A government-portal shell wrapping a standalone widget — colors, fonts, radii and spacing each their own system, visibly bolted together.
critiques.after: One design system: a bright white canvas with purple-blue accents, a unified type family, radii / spacing / shadows across the whole page.

critiques.title: Weak hierarchy, no primary action
critiques.before: Query, results, docs, citation and downloads pile up flat with no focal point; users don’t know where to start.
critiques.after: A clear hero + one primary action (query); core split into numbered 01–03 sections, with downloads/coefficients/docs demoted to a dedicated Resources band.

critiques.title: Disconnected I/O, no visualization
critiques.before: The platform only takes Galactic coords; if you have RA/Dec you convert by hand. Results are bare numbers with no context.
critiques.after: Built-in frame switch and auto-conversion; results paired with a cumulative-extinction curve and a sky locator, with units and σ.

critiques.title: No guidance or term explanations
critiques.before: No explanation of E(B−V), mag/kpc or “max reliable distance” — novices are lost and experts must guess the conventions.
critiques.after: Each metric carries a short caption and convention tags, and reddening coefficients sit right in the results for instant conversion.

critiques.title: Poor interaction affordances
critiques.before: Plain text links, no hover/focus feedback, no error or out-of-range warnings, layout breaks on mobile.
critiques.after: Clear buttons / segmented controls / focus + hover states, error + over-distance warnings, responsive grid.

critiques.title: Tools disconnected from the core
critiques.before: A character counter unrelated to extinction; a coordinate tool reinventing what the query needs — orphaned, drifting features.
critiques.after: Coordinate results “send to query” in one click; utilities live in one area, support material in its own Resources band — a closed loop.

query.intro: 输入一个视线方向与日心距离，立即得到沿该方向、积分到该距离处的累积消光 E(B−V) 及其不确定度，并可展开各测光波段的红化系数。

steps.d: 银道 (l, b) 或赤道 (RA, Dec)，单位均为度。
单位 kpc，对应积分到的日心距离（约 0–18 kpc）。
得到 E(B−V)、密度 dE/dx、消光上限距离、局部气泡半径与沿线分子云。
查看各测光系统 R_λ，按 A_λ = R_λ · E(B−V) 换算到任意波段。

caveats: 距离超过模型有效范围（约 18 kpc）时为外推，仅供参考。
高银纬（|b|>30°）尘埃稀薄，E(B−V) 与 σ 都很小。
σ 为模型 1σ 统计不确定度，不含系统误差。

plot.intro: 设定绘图区域与绘图参数，按选定投影方式渲染整个天球的累积消光分布。

steps.d: 坐标系与 l / b / d 范围，限定绘图的天区与积分距离。
高斯核 σ、颜色编码范围、颜色缩放（hist / linear / log）与颜色映射。
笛卡尔 / 正射 / 正交 / 斜剖面投影，点“生成消光图”重绘。

caveats: 颜色标度受颜色缩放与范围控制，银道面 (b≈0) 最亮。
笛卡尔投影下可点击图面拾取 (l, b)。

batch.intro: 一次粘贴多条视线，逐行返回 E(B−V) 与 σ，结果可导出为 CSV，适合批量处理星表。

steps.d: 银道或赤道，作用于整批输入。
格式 “coord1, coord2, distance”，逗号或空格分隔。
表格逐行输出结果，点击下载 CSV。

caveats: 建议单次不超过数千行以保证响应。
缺失或非法距离的行会被标记或跳过。

tools.intro: 三件常用的天文换算小工具：坐标换算、角尺度与物理尺度互算、以及文本统计。

steps.d: 在赤道 / 银道 / 黄道 / 直角坐标间互转，结果可“发送到消光查询”。
由距离与物理直径求角直径，或由角直径反推物理尺度。
统计字符数、词数等。

caveats: 坐标采用 ICRS J2000、黄赤交角 ε=23.4393°；XYZ 为日心直角坐标。

query.intro: Enter one line of sight and a heliocentric distance to instantly get the cumulative extinction E(B−V) integrated to that distance, with its uncertainty — and expand reddening coefficients per photometric band.

steps.d: Galactic (l, b) or Equatorial (RA, Dec), both in degrees.
In kpc — the heliocentric distance to integrate to (~0–18 kpc).
Returns E(B−V), density dE/dx, max-extinction distance, local-bubble radius and clouds along the line.
See R_λ per system; convert to any band via A_λ = R_λ · E(B−V).

caveats: Beyond the model range (~18 kpc) results are extrapolated.
At high latitude (|b|>30°) dust is thin, so E(B−V) and σ are small.
σ is the 1σ statistical uncertainty only — no systematics.

plot.intro: Set the map region and plot parameters, then render the all-sky cumulative extinction in the chosen projection.

steps.d: Coordinate frame and l / b / d ranges define the sky window and integration distance.
Gaussian σ, color-coding range, color scale (hist / linear / log) and colormap.
Cartesian / orthographic / orthogonal / oblique-slice; hit “Generate map” to redraw.

caveats: The color scale follows the chosen scaling and range; the Galactic plane (b≈0) is brightest.
In Cartesian projection you can click the map to pick (l, b).

batch.intro: Paste many lines of sight at once and get E(B−V) and σ row by row, exportable as CSV — ideal for catalogues.

steps.d: Galactic or Equatorial, applied to the whole batch.
Format “coord1, coord2, distance”, comma- or space-separated.
Results stream into a table; click to download CSV.

caveats: Keep to a few thousand rows per run for responsiveness.
Rows with missing/invalid distance are flagged or skipped.

tools.intro: Three handy converters: coordinate transforms, angular ↔ physical size, and text statistics.

steps.d: Between Equatorial / Galactic / Ecliptic / Cartesian; send the result straight to a query.
Get angular diameter from distance + physical size, or invert it.
Count characters, words and more.

caveats: Conventions: ICRS J2000, obliquity ε=23.4393°; XYZ is heliocentric.

codeSnippet:
from dustmaps3d import dustmaps3d
import numpy as np

l = np.array([160.0])   # Galactic longitude
b = np.array([20.0])    # Galactic latitude
d = np.array([1.5])     # distance in kpc

EBV, dust_density, sigma, max_d = dustmaps3d(l, b, d)
print(EBV)              # E(B-V) [mag]
